title: Read a hosted history page
responsibility: Read one page of source history and expose commit events with completeness metadata.

inputs.name: hubHistory.context
inputs.description: Provides the repository, commit, and source adapter used for the history read. The adapter must expose a historyPage function or the call fails with history-unavailable.

inputs.name: hubHistory.input
inputs.type: { branch?: string; paths: string[]; page?: number }
inputs.description: Supplies repository paths and an optional page number to the history adapter. The page defaults to 1, while branch is accepted but ignored.

outputs.name: hubHistory
outputs.description: Resolves to a page of commit events sorted by descending authored time; the adapter is asked for 20 commits per page. The complete and nextPage fields come from the adapter.

entries.title: Update hosted history reader
entries.detail: Committed change. Measurements and verification are recorded separately.

errors.name: history-unavailable
errors.description: Raised when the source adapter has no historyPage function. The history page cannot be read in that case.
